pxtone, Studio Pixel's (Daisuke Amaya) "pxtone play sample" source release 2022-09-10a (pxtone/ folder, vendored unchanged apart from
dropping the Visual Studio project files). Upstream: https://studiopixel.jp/ (pxtone source code 220910a, ReadMe[JP].txt).
Licence (translated from ReadMe[JP].txt, section "License"): the playback source code (pxtone folder) is free to use and modify,
no permission is needed, crediting is up to the user, no liability for any problem caused by its use. No COPYING file exists
upstream; this note is the licence record. Ogg Vorbis woices (pxINCLUDE_OGGVORBIS) are left disabled.
